integrity: One-turn circular scattered subsequences are the union over possible source rotations, not the prior fixed-cut circular universality notion. Finite exhaustiveness is supported by two exact enumeration methods and executable source; no independent mathematical validation is claimed.
scientific_limitations: The first-failure and uniqueness census covers binary necklaces of circumferences 2 through 14 only; the infinite two-parameter family is proved directly. No complete higher-length obstruction classification is claimed.
title: First sharp failure of count-and-transition bounds for adaptive circular subsequences
